faq_heading: Homes near Brooke Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Brooke Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Delta School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Brooke Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Brooke Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Brooke Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 55 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,160,000, townhomes $814,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Brooke Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Brooke Elementary the median was 33 days on the market, closing at 96.0% of the list price, with 4% of sales above the list price for the 55 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Brooke Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Devon Gardens Elementary (0.8 km east), Annieville Elementary (1.4 km north-east) and Home Quest (1.4 km north-east).

Brooke Elementary is an elementary school in Delta (Delta School District), at 8718 Delwood Dr. It teaches grades K to 7.
The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names Brooke Elementary. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 1 km of the school.
How the Brooke Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Brooke Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Brooke Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 55 homes sold within 1 km of Brooke Elementary: 41 houses, 12 townhomes and 1 condo. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,160,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Brooke Elementary

19 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Brooke Elementary in a straight line (12 elementary, 5 secondary, 2 other; 1 independent). The closest is Devon Gardens Elementary, 0.8 km away, and the farthest on this list is Kirkbride Elementary, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Sands Secondary (1.6 km); the nearest independent school is Immaculate Conception School (2.4 km). Other elementary schools close by: Devon Gardens Elementary (0.8 km east), Annieville Elementary (1.4 km north-east), Richardson Elementary (1.5 km south-east), Gibson Elementary (1.5 km east), Gray Elementary (1.6 km south). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Devon Gardens Elementary, 0.8 km east of Brooke Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Brooke Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Delta school finder. A home a few blocks from Brooke Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Brooke Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 1 km of Brooke Elementary was $1,160,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at Devon Gardens Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 0.8 km east of Brooke Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
